# External User Friction Audit

Date: 2026-07-30  
Release line: direct hardening descendant of `maestro-template-v0.2.0-alpha.2`

This audit compares the factory and generated `saas-application` target with the
Signal Scout external-user failure ledger. It does not claim that generic
factory changes repair Signal Scout product behavior, private-provider access,
host permissions, or workflow features that the compatibility ledger still
restricts.

## Reproduced Commands

All commands used Node `22.23.2`; the active package manager was pnpm `10.12.1`.

| Command                                                  | Evidence                                                                                                   |
| -------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `node scripts/maestro-bootstrap.mjs --json`              | Exit 0; one JSON document; pinned Node/pnpm and Git identity passed; exact install command returned.       |
| `node maestro-template.mjs --help`                       | Exit 0; root help includes generated-app, factory, shared workflow, and explicit start-port surfaces.      |
| `node maestro-template.mjs scaffold --help`              | Exit 0; exact preview/write fingerprints and workflow review flags are discoverable.                       |
| `pnpm template:systems -- --query social sync`           | Exit 1; reports `Ambiguous arguments after --query: sync` and instructs the user to quote `"social sync"`. |
| `node maestro-template.mjs preflight --mode fake --json` | Exit 0; stdout parsed as one JSON document; fake mode required no network or authentication.               |

## Focused Closure Evidence

- CLI launcher, scaffold, receipt adapter, and start adapter: 27/27 tests.
- Agent Pack scaffold, receipts/readiness, ports, and start: 76/76 tests.
- Customer target integrity, materialization, and release adapter: 31/31 tests.
- Canonical release-root materialization and customer compilation: 8/8 tests.
- Generator direct-run and complete generator behavior: 59/59 tests.
- Codegen snapshot semantics: 3/3 tests; the actual offline Convex check
  reported `Generated files are up-to-date` and
  `Codegen introduced no generated drift.`

  295/295; and final customer filesystem 2/2.

  Effect diagnostics (0 errors and 0 warnings), build (20/20 tasks), generator,

- The canonical `check:secret-canaries` repository scan completed with

- The focused production web build exited 0 without an oversized-chunk warning;
